inference_policy: A topic-mismatched supplied source must be disclosed and rejected in the first sentence even when the symptom is urgent.
When source mismatch and urgent care both apply, the first sentence must combine the evidence boundary and urgent action.
Immediate self-harm responses must explicitly direct means separation, nearby-person support, and emergency contact without omitting any action.
